deny "BLOCKED: gitleaks found ${nd_count} secret-shaped string(s) in staged file(s) of ${repo_root} carrying a \x5c`-diff\x5c` gitattribute: ${nd_files%, }. A \x5c`-diff\x5c` attribute makes git emit \x5c"Binary files … differ\x5c" with no added lines, so the normal staged scan sees NOTHING in these files — they were re-scanned from their staged blobs. Recovery: (1) scrub the secret bytes (never commit-then-rotate); (2) if the \x5c`-diff\x5c` attribute is not deliberate, remove it from .gitattributes / .git/info/attributes."
echo "[git-commit-secret-scan] WARN: .gitleaks.toml not found at repo root — skipping scan." >&2
echo "[git-commit-secret-scan] WARN: .gitleaks.toml not found at repo root $_r — skipping scan of it." >&2

reason="BLOCKED: brand-hex-commit-gate found ${count} raw hex colour literal(s) in staged UI/template content. Locations: ${locs}. Remediation: components/pages MUST reference a design token (var(--…) or the bg-/text-/border- token utility from globals.css), never a raw hex literal; email templates permit inline hex but ONLY brand-palette colours (off-palette hex is off-brand). Palette + token names are discovered from the project's token-definition CSS. See knowledge-base/marketing/brand-guide.md. This gate is the un-bypassable commit-time layer (#4644); the review-time frontend-anti-slop scanner (#4635) is the second net."

reason="BLOCKED: gitleaks found ${findings_count} secret-shaped string(s) in the staged index of ${repo_root}. Locations: ${findings_summary}. The default action is to scrub the secrets — never commit-then-rotate. Recovery: (1) unstage the offending file(s) in ${repo_root} with 'git restore --staged <path>'; (2) redact the secret bytes in place; (3) re-stage and retry. If the staged content is a captured-real fixture from 'terraform show -json' or similar, strip the '.variables' block — terraform-show-json embeds sensitive HCL variables verbatim regardless of sensitive=true. See knowledge-base/project/learnings/security-issues/2026-05-25-terraform-show-json-leaks-sensitive-variables-into-fixtures.md."
